service.name: Voice-fronted cover band
service.serviceType: Voice-fronted covers for private and corporate events
service.description: Covers fronted by Tejas Singh, booked as a duo, trio or quartet for private and corporate events in Denver, the Front Range and the Colorado mountain corridor.

faqs.a: Covers, fronted by one voice and often built live with a looper, from the Beatles and Bob Marley to the songs of the last twenty years. He also plays his own singer-songwriter material when you want it. He's a Denver musician booked through Signet Artists as a duo, a trio or a quartet.

As a duo under dinner, it sits at the level of the conversation. At quartet size on the dance floor, it's as loud as a band at a good party. The band moves between the two on cue and sets the level to the space, and if your venue has a sound limit, give us the number.
No. Nobody changes costume, there's no choreography and there's no host segment. The band plays, reads the floor and plays the next song.

faqs.q: Can we ask for a song?
faqs.a: Yes. One learned song of your choosing comes with every booking, often the first dance at a wedding, and if the night runs long, another half hour is easy to add on the night.
